summary: Elmet Group's subsidiary Elmet Technologies signed a September 3, 2026 asset purchase agreement with OSRAM GmbH to buy substantially all assets of OSRAM's Schwabmünchen, Germany tungsten and molybdenum metal production business, including powders, rods, wire and electrodes, assuming employee, pension and contract liabilities. Purchase price is a formula: negative €18M fixed, plus pension assets, minus defined benefit obligations, minus €1M restructuring prepayment, adjusted versus €3.875M working capital. No real property transfers; OSRAM retains premises and continues other operations. Closing conditions and regulatory timing remain to be satisfied; watch pension and working-capital true-ups and antitrust clearance.
